programs.title: Wardens of the North
programs.desc: The lives of men and women who are making the Michigan wilderness and landscape a safer place for not only animals, but humans alike.

programs.title: Wardens of the North
programs.desc: A hunter who mistakenly takes down an antlered elk must face the consequences; a warden must come down hard on an ORV hunter who is skirting the law; a warden investigates a hunter on private property.

programs.title: Wardens of the North
programs.sub_title: I Told That Sherriff to Call
programs.desc: A warden checks on a hunter he suspects may be illegally baiting deer. A warden tracks down hunters using blinds on state land and finds they aren't quite abiding by the law. Wardens enforce the law with anglers on the Detroit River.

programs.title: Wardens of the North
programs.desc: Officers encounter many hunters on the opening day of waterfowl season; Chief Haines and his friends enjoy hunting during their annual Grouse Camp trip, and activities heat up on the lake as patrons celebrate the 4th of July.

programs.title: Yellowstone Wardens
programs.desc: In Region 7, wardens launch a mission to stop illegal road hunters; the team gathers to celebrate a veteran warden's legacy and reminisce about his long, impactful career.

programs.title: Yellowstone Wardens
programs.desc: Region 1 wardens are left speechless after witnessing a squatter on public land and are on high alert during the annual Yellowstone River Boat Float; during the pursuit of upland game, a license check comes up empty and the wardens scramble.

programs.title: Yellowstone Wardens
programs.desc: A warden follows the trail to locate a mysterious group of hunters; a warden makes memories to last a lifetime when he draws a coveted mule deer tag; wardens catch illegal hunters in the act during the bighorn sheep and archery elk-hunting seasons.

programs.title: Yellowstone Wardens
programs.desc: Wardens help rescue a hunter with a broken leg. Hunters coming through a warden check station get into hot water after not telling the truth. Meanwhile, wildlife decoys are deployed across the state to catch poachers, and it yields surprising results.
